description: Defines the UploadFileElementReader class, an implementation of UploadElementReader for handling file uploads, including methods for initialization, reading, and managing file info, with support for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: UploadFileElementReader
classes.description: An implementation of UploadElementReader for reading files to be uploaded, supporting asynchronous operations and range-based reading.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader
methods.description: Constructs an UploadFileElementReader with a file or file path, range, and expected modification time.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the file path associated with this reader.

methods.name: range_offset
methods.description: Returns the offset within the file from which reading starts.

methods.name: range_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the data to be read.

methods.name: expected_modification_time
methods.description: Returns the expected last modification time of the file.

methods.name: AsFileReader
methods.description: Returns a pointer to this object as a file reader.

methods.name: GetContentLength
methods.description: Returns the total content length to be uploaded.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining to be read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, possibly asynchronously.
